name: skillsdugout
description: Curated Claude skills, ready to be called in.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Writes a compact handoff file so the next session continues without re-explaining.

plugins.name: comment-hygiene
plugins.description: Keeps code comments brief, factual and self-contained; removes stale claims, cross-references and AI conversation residue without changing behavior.

plugins.name: analyse-parallel-bugs
plugins.description: Triages several reported problems at once: finds how many real causes there are, verifies each, and orders them by consequence.

plugins.name: bug-ticket
plugins.description: Turns a bug into a self-contained ticket developers can build from and QA can sign off against, with every claim labelled by how it is known.

plugins.name: test-scenarios
plugins.description: Writes short, runnable test scenarios in plain business words, each with setup, action, expected result and status.

plugins.name: commit-messages
plugins.description: Writes Conventional Commits messages and matching branch names that say what is now true, with a ticket or area scope.

plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Puts each CLAUDE.md note in the deepest file it applies to, so project memory stays short and accurate.

plugins.name: diagrams-from-spec
plugins.description: House rules for generating architecture and flow diagrams from a committed spec with Archify, and embedding them in docs.

plugins.name: changelog-why
plugins.description: Writes changelog entries that say what changed for the reader and why it matters, without invented claims.
